errors.evidence: The description inaccurately indicates that the highest bar reaches 1550 million BGN when the graph shows it is approximately 1400 million BGN.
The description inaccurately reports the lowest values in 2019 as 330–350 million BGN, when they are actually about 400 million BGN.
The description incorrectly identifies the color of 'Акции на АДСИЦ' as brown/redish when it appears in light brown.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state the overall purpose of the chart, which is to compare the turnover of financial instruments at BFB over the years.
The description does not mention the distinct grouping structure of the segments and their corresponding colors and sizes.
